name: Yamaha XT500
engine: 499 cc air-cooled SOHC single, one carb, kick start, dry sump (oil in the frame)
intro: The classic big thumper. Kick start technique, the carb and the oil-in-frame system matter most.

add.title: Flush the oil frame
add.instructions: The frame holds the engine oil. Drain it fully and flush out sludge and rust before refilling.
add.reason: Old sludge in the frame goes straight into the engine.

G: Starting problems are often the carb. A rebuild kit is cheap.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.

known.title: Kick start ratchet
known.what: Owners report cracked kick start ratchets, often from kicking too hard. Yamaha revised the part.
